import pandas as pd, glob, os
allrows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
    x=pd.read_csv(f, dtype={'cancelled':'boolean'})
    carrier=os.path.basename(f)[:2]
    x['carrier']=carrier
    datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in x else 'date'
    sched='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in x else 'sched_dep'
    actual='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in x else 'actual_dep'
    x['date_used']=x[datecol]
    x['sched_used']=x[sched]; x['actual_used']=x[actual]
    allrows.append(x[['flight_id','carrier','date_used','sched_used','actual_used','cancelled']])
df=pd.concat(allrows, ignore_index=True)
print('rows',len(df),'unique ids',df.flight_id.nunique(),'duplicates',df.flight_id.duplicated().sum())
print('date range',df.date_used.min(),df.date_used.max(), 'cancelled',df.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
print('duplicate IDs',df.loc[df.flight_id.duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values('flight_id').to_dict('records'))
# parse and delay
sched_dt=pd.to_datetime(df.date_used+' '+df.sched_used, errors='coerce')
actual_dt=pd.to_datetime(df.date_used+' '+df.actual_used, errors='coerce')
df['delay']=(actual_dt-sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
# identify missing/non cancelled and negative suspicious
print('missing delays noncancel',df.loc[(~df.cancelled)&df.delay.isna()].to_dict('records'))
print(df.groupby('carrier').agg(rows=('flight_id','size'), unique=('flight_id','nunique'), cancelled=('cancelled',lambda x: (x==True).sum()), completed=('cancelled',lambda x: (x==False).sum()), delayed=('delay',lambda x: (x>15).sum()), delay_sum=('delay','sum')))
completed=df[df.cancelled==False]
print('network completed',len(completed),'delayed', (completed.delay>15).sum(),'rate',100*(completed.delay>15).mean())

# Deduplicate by unique flight_id, retain first (verify duplicate rows identical)
df2=df.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
# month filter scheduled date Jan-Feb
m=df2['date_used'].between('2025-01-01','2025-02-28')
x=df2[m].copy()
raw=x.delay.copy()
print('dedup total',len(df2),'JanFeb',len(x),'date counts',x.date_used.str[:7].value_counts().sort_index().to_dict())
print('cancel JanFeb',x.cancelled.value_counts().to_dict())
print('raw delay min/max',raw.min(),raw.max(),'very negative',x.loc[raw<-120,['flight_id','date_used','sched_used','actual_used','delay']].to_dict('records'))
# corrected for next-day if raw less than -12h; calculate
x['delay_corrected']=raw.where(raw>=-720,raw+1440)
comp=x[x.cancelled==False]
print('completed',len(comp),'delayed raw',(comp.delay>15).sum(),'delayed corrected',(comp.delay_corrected>15).sum(),'rate corrected',round(100*(comp.delay_corrected>15).sum()/len(comp),10))
print('by carrier',x.groupby('carrier').apply(lambda z: pd.Series({'completed':(z.cancelled==False).sum(),'delayed':((z.cancelled==False)&(z.delay_corrected>15)).sum()}),include_groups=False))

events.notes: Combined all six carrier files, removed 12 repeated flight records by flight_id, restricted scheduled dates to January-February 2025, excluded 38 cancellations, and computed actual-minus-scheduled departure delay. I accounted for departures after midnight by treating large negative clock differences as next-day departures. Result: 453 delayed completed flights / 1,891 completed flights = 24.0% (rounded to 1 decimal).
